parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing support for all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the door, drawer, and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that serves as the foundation for the entire cabinet.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment located at the top of the cabinet, made of solid wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small, easily accessible storage space for utensils or small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and supports the weight of the cabinet and its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that rests on the floor.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal wooden panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on the design.
